s.note: Crisp rolled tortillas with beef chilli and cheese. The 7-Eleven clerk doubts Jordan.
s.how: Brown the mince with the onion, then add the cumin, chilli and passata and simmer until thick. Warm the tortillas so they bend, then fill each with chilli and cheese and roll up tight. Brush with oil and bake seam-side down at 220C until crisp. Serve with sour cream and salsa.

s.note: Cold king prawns in Marie Rose sauce on iceberg. A Vegas win.
s.how: Stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, Worcestershire and a squeeze of lemon together. Fill 4 coupes with lettuce and avocado. Pile on the prawns, spoon over the sauce and dust with paprika. Serve cold with lemon wedges.

m.note: Carolina vinegar pork and slaw in soft white rolls. A visit to Wilmington.
m.how: Rub the pork with the sugar, paprika and salt and sit it in a lidded pot with 250ml water. Cover and cook at 160C until it pulls apart easily. Shake the vinegar, chilli flakes and tomato sauce together, then pull the pork and toss it through. Dress the cabbage with the mayo and a splash of the sauce and pile into the rolls with the pork.

m.note: Grilled sirloin with fries and pepper sauce. Dinner with George Raveling.
m.how: Boil the chips for 5 minutes, drain, toss with 2 tbsp oil and roast at 220C until crisp. Season the steaks and sear in the remaining oil to your liking, then rest. In the same pan melt the butter, soften the shallot, add the pepper, cream and mustard and bubble until thick. Serve the steaks with the fries and sauce.

w.note: Red velvet layers with cream cheese and dark chocolate. Air Jordan.
w.how: Whisk the flour, cocoa, bicarb and sugar, then beat in the oil, eggs, buttermilk, colouring and vinegar. Split between 2 lined 20cm tins and bake at 175C until a skewer comes out clean, then cool. Beat the cream cheese, butter and icing sugar until fluffy. Sandwich and cover the cakes with the icing and press the grated chocolate around the sides.

d.note: Bourbon stirred with bitters and orange peel. Deloris wants a cut.
d.how: Stir the bourbon, syrup and bitters with ice until very cold. Strain over fresh ice in 4 short glasses. Twist the orange peel over each glass and drop in with a cherry.
